title: Clients & years
covers: the year card: form, audit, stage

steps.say: Clients and years is the firm's register. Every assessee is entered once, and carried into each assessment year.
Pick the assessment year here. Each row shows the return form, a 3 C D tag when the year is audited, and the stage it has reached.

New client opens the master: name, status, PAN, contacts, GST, bank accounts, and partners for a firm. The PAN's fourth letter must match the status, and a GSTIN must carry the same PAN, so a typing slip is caught before it reaches a return.
Once saved, the client starts in the current year, ready for the statements to come in.
